description_en: Performs a paged query for the resource and session events of the current account within the last 30 days. Paging is supported
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号近 30 天内的资源与会话事件
name: DescribeEvents

parameters.help_en: The event ID, used to query a specific event. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by event ID
parameters.help_zh: 事件 ID，用于精确查询单个事件；不传时不按事件 ID 筛选
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en: The event type identifier, used to filter events. Different products may generate different event types. This operation does not restrict the value to a fixed enumeration. You should use the EventType values retrieved from EventList as filter values
parameters.help_zh: 事件类型标识，用于精确筛选事件。不同产品可能产生不同类型，本接口不限定固定枚举；应使用已查询到的 `EventList.EventType` 作为筛选值
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The product type. The value is case-insensitive. If you specify an invalid value, the request fails. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by product type. Only the following public product values are supported:

`CloudApp`: Wuying Cloud Application.
`CloudBrowser`: Cloud Browser.
`WuyingServer`: Enterprise Edition Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstation`: Personal Edition Linggou Container Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`: Linggou Team Edition Container Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`: Linggou Dedicated Edition Container Workstation.
`AndroidCloud`: Cloud Phone.
`AIAgent`: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。取值不区分大小写；传入其他值时请求失败。不传时不按产品类型筛选。仅支持以下公开产品值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器。
`WuyingServer`：企业版工作站。
`WuyingWorkstation`：个人版灵构容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`：灵构团队版容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`：灵构专属版容器工作站。
`AndroidCloud`：云手机。
`AIAgent`：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The end user ID, used to filter events generated by a specific user. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by user
parameters.help_zh: 终端用户 ID，用于精确筛选该用户产生的事件；不传时不按用户筛选
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The delivery group ID, used to filter events of a specific delivery group. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by delivery group. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于精确筛选交付组事件；不传时不按交付组筛选。可先调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The delivery group name. If the name contains only letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, events are filtered by name prefix. If the name contains spaces or other special characters, events are filtered by the exact name. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by name
parameters.help_zh: 交付组名称。仅由文字、数字、下划线或连字符组成时按名称前缀筛选；包含空格或其他特殊字符时按完整值筛选。不传时不按名称筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: The business region ID of the event, used for exact filtering. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by business region. You can call the [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 事件所属的业务地域 ID，用于精确筛选；不传时不按业务地域筛选。可调用 [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) 获取
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the member elastic network interface (ENI) of the cloud resource, used to filter related events. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by IP address
parameters.help_zh: 云资源成员网卡的私网 IP 地址，用于精确筛选相关事件；不传时不按 IP 地址筛选
parameters.name: member_eni_ip

parameters.help_en: The office network ID, used to filter events generated within a specific office network. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by office network
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络 ID，用于精确筛选办公网络内产生的事件；不传时不按办公网络筛选
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Required. Use the ISO 8601 format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss`. You can include three-digit milliseconds and use `Z` or `±HH:mm` to specify the time zone. We recommend that you always include the time zone offset. The query includes this time, and the start time must be earlier than or equal to the `EndTime`. The service only retains and retrieves events that occurred within 30 days before the call time
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，必填。使用 ISO 8601 格式：`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss`，可带三位毫秒，并可使用 `Z` 或 `±HH:mm` 指明时区。建议始终携带时区偏移；查询包含该时刻，且应早于或等于 `EndTime`。服务只保留并检索调用时刻之前 30 天内的事件
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Required. The format is the same as that of `StartTime`. We recommend that you always include the time zone offset. The query includes this time, and the end time cannot be earlier than the `StartTime`. A time range later than the call time does not generate future events
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必填。格式与 `StartTime` 相同，建议始终携带时区偏移；查询包含该时刻，且不能早于 `StartTime`。晚于调用时刻的范围不会产生未来事件
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of events to return on each page. Default value: 10. This operation does not declare a fixed upper limit. We recommend that you set this parameter to a reasonable positive integer based on your actual needs
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的事件数。不传时默认 10。当前接口未声明固定上限，建议按实际需要设置合理的正整数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1. This parameter is used together with `PageSize`
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码，从 `1` 开始。不传时默认 1；与 `PageSize` 配合使用
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: A compatibility field. The current version does not read this parameter. Use `PageSize` to control the number of records on each page
parameters.help_zh: 兼容字段。当前版本不读取该参数；请使用 `PageSize` 控制每页记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A compatibility field. The current version does not read this parameter and does not support token-based pagination. Use `PageNumber`
parameters.help_zh: 兼容字段。当前版本不读取该参数，不支持使用令牌翻页；请使用 `PageNumber`
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The application instance ID, used to filter events associated with a specific instance. If you do not specify this parameter, events are not filtered by application instance. To obtain this value, first call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the delivery group ID, and then use the ID as `AppInstanceGroupId` to call the [ListAppInstances](~~ListAppInstances~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用实例 ID，用于精确筛选该实例关联的事件；不传时不按应用实例筛选。获取该值时，先调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取交付组 ID，再将该 ID 作为 `AppInstanceGroupId` 调用 [ListAppInstances](~~ListAppInstances~~)
parameters.name: app_instance_id

EventList.description_en: The list of events on the current page, returned in descending order of the event log time
EventList.description_zh: 当前页的事件列表，按事件日志时间倒序返回

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the delivery group associated with the event. This field may be empty if the event is not associated with a delivery group
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 事件关联的交付组 ID；事件不关联交付组时可能为空

AppInstanceGroupName.description_en: The name of the delivery group associated with the event. This field may be empty if the event is not associated with a delivery group
AppInstanceGroupName.description_zh: 事件关联的交付组名称；事件不关联交付组时可能为空

DetailInfo.description_en: The event detail text. The content varies based on the `EventType` and may be empty. For example, a session release event may return a JSON text that describes the release cause
DetailInfo.description_zh: 事件详情文本，内容随 `EventType` 变化，可能为空；例如会话释放事件可返回 JSON 文本说明释放原因

EventId.description_en: The unique identifier of the event

EventType.description_en: The event type identifier. Different products may return different values. You can use this value for subsequent exact filtering
EventType.description_zh: 事件类型标识。不同产品可能返回不同值，可将该值用于后续精确筛选

MemberEniIp.description_en: The private IP address of the member ENI of the cloud resource associated with the event. This field may be empty if it is not applicable
MemberEniIp.description_zh: 事件关联的云资源成员网卡私网 IP 地址；不适用时可能为空

OccurredTime.description_en: The time when the event occurred. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. Time zone: UTC+8 (Asia/Shanghai)
OccurredTime.description_zh: 事件发生时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，时区：UTC+8（Asia/Shanghai）

OfficeSiteId.description_en: The ID of the office network associated with the event. This field may be empty if it is not applicable
OfficeSiteId.description_zh: 事件关联的办公网络 ID；不适用时可能为空

ProductType.description_en: The product type to which the event belongs. This field is an open string and may be extended as supported event sources expand. Callers should not restrict the value to the products currently listed in the `ProductType` request parameter
ProductType.description_zh: 事件所属的产品类型。该字段为开放字符串，可能随支持的事件来源扩展；调用方不应将取值限定为请求参数 `ProductType` 当前列出的产品

UserId.description_en: The ID of the end user who generated the event. This field may be empty if the event is not associated with an end user
UserId.description_zh: 产生该事件的终端用户 ID；事件不关联终端用户时可能为空

MaxResults.description_en: A compatibility field. The current version does not set this field. Do not rely on its value
MaxResults.description_zh: 兼容字段。当前版本不设置该字段，请勿依赖其值

NextToken.description_en: A compatibility field. The current version does not generate a next page token. Do not use this field for pagination
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容字段。当前版本不生成下一页令牌，请勿使用该字段翻页

PageNumber.description_en: The page number corresponding to the current response

PageSize.description_en: The number of events per page used in the current response
PageSize.description_zh: 本次响应采用的每页事件数

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of events that meet all filter conditions within the 30-day retrievable window. Unit: entries
TotalCount.description_zh: 在近 30 天可检索窗口内满足全部筛选条件的事件总数。单位：条
